stem.text: The graph shows the effect of an increasing substrate concentration on the rate of an enzyme-catalysed reaction.

stem.alt: Graph of rate of reaction against substrate concentration, with a dashed horizontal line marked maximum rate of reaction and two curves labelled P (solid) and Q (dashed).

stem.text: Line P represents the result when the enzyme is used at its optimum pH and optimum temperature and without an inhibitor.
Line Q represents the result when the reaction conditions are changed.
Which descriptions of changes to the reaction conditions could result in line Q if all other conditions were kept the same?

items: Add an inhibitor that attaches to a site other than the active site.
Add an inhibitor that has a similar shape to the substrate.
Add an inhibitor that blocks the active site of the enzyme.
Carry out the reaction at a higher temperature.
